entries.label_zh: 支付制度試辦計畫 (110/12/13起) 註： 健保署針對西醫門診醫療費用之案件分類申報方式說明如下： (1) 採日劑藥費申報者，案件分類為「01：西醫一般案件」，惟慢性病不得以一般案件申報。 (2) 健保署公告之慢性病，其費用申報之案件分類應為「04：西醫慢性病」。 (3) 經醫師確認保險對象病情穩定，可長期使用同一處方藥品治療時，得開給「全民健康保險門診交付調劑箋」並勾選「連續處方箋」，當次費用之案件分類為「04：西醫慢性病」；保險對象逕持慢性病連續處方箋調劑者，案件分類為「08：慢性病連續處方調劑」。 (4) 不屬上開規定之案件分類者，則為「09：西醫其他專案」。 (5) 若同時有急性、慢性病一起診治時，其案件分類應為「09：西醫其他專案」。若併開給慢性病連續處方箋者，應申報案件分類為「04：西醫慢性病」，另項次22「給藥日份」依當次慢性病給藥品項最高之天數填報。（9303修訂） (6) 案件分類「01:一般案件」案件，經採交付調劑，應改以「09:西醫其他專案」申報。 2026年01月27日修訂
entries.label_en: Note: The NHIA describes case classification for Western-medicine outpatient fees as follows: (1) For daily-dose drug-fee billing, the class is '01: Western-medicine general case', but chronic disease may not be billed as a general case. (2) For NHIA-announced chronic diseases, the class should be '04: Western-medicine chronic disease'. (3) When a physician confirms the condition is stable and the same prescription can be used long-term, a 'refillable prescription' may be issued and that visit's class is '04: chronic disease'; if the insured presents the refillable prescription directly, the class is '08: chronic refillable-prescription dispensing'. (4) Cases not covered above are '09: Western-medicine other special case'. (5) When acute and chronic disease are treated together, the class is '09: other special case'; if a refillable chronic prescription is also issued, report class '04', and fill item 22 'days of medication' with the highest day count among the chronic drugs (revised ROC 93/03). (6) A '01: general case' dispensed via referral should be reported as '09'.

Supplementary notes on case enrollment, follow-up, and annual assessment for the National Health Insurance Metabolic Syndrome Prevention Program: (1) Each preventive health service may, as clinically needed, be combined with other general treatment by the same attending physician (e.g., prescribing cold medicine) without requiring an additional NHI card stamp, and no co-payment may be charged for that visit. entries.label_zh: 112/3/20 Paxlovid、Molnupiravir等) 2026年01月27日修訂註： (1) 符合代碼4、5與6規定者，如有物理治療業務者，仍各依該代碼申報。 (2) 醫藥分業實施滿一年地區，其代碼應為0、1、2與6請參考第4點之說明。 (3) 慢性病連續處方調劑及中醫本欄免填補空白；預防保健則本欄為非必要欄位。 (4) 處方調劑方式補充說明： a、 交付調劑案件其藥品品項、用法、總量請核實填寫申報，門診醫療服務醫令清單項次9「醫令類別」欄請填寫4，單價及點數則填入0。 b、 案件分類原符合「一般案件」者，應以「其他專案」申報。 c、 處方交付調劑案件，若患者需要注射及領取口服藥時，則醫師得於診所中以自備之注射藥品為病患注射，僅交付口服藥處方；醫師得申報注射藥品費用（若屬大型點滴注射時，得同時申報注射技術費）、空針費用及交付調劑之門診診察費，惟不得申報藥事服務費，「處方調劑方式」則仍填寫「１（交付調劑）」。 右靠不足補0，此項費用為醫令（資料格式12）醫令類別為１之用藥明細點數（項次14） 之小計；如為交付調劑之藥品費用，不得併入用藥明細點數小計內計算；西醫一般案件及中醫請依給藥日份計算用藥申報點數
entries.label_en: ROC 112/3/20, Paxlovid, Molnupiravir, etc.) Revised 2026/01/27. Note: (1) Those meeting the criteria for codes 4, 5, and 6, if also providing physical therapy services, shall still report under the respective code. (2) In areas where separation of medicine dispensing has been implemented for over one year, the code shall be 0, 1, 2, or 6; see the explanation in point 4. (3) This field may be left blank for chronic disease continuous prescription dispensing and Chinese medicine; for preventive health care this field is not required. (4) Supplementary explanation of prescription dispensing methods: a. For prescription-transfer dispensing cases, the drug items, usage, and total quantity shall be truthfully filled in and reported; item 9 'order category' in the outpatient medical order list shall be entered as 4, with unit price and points entered as 0. b. Cases originally classified as 'general case' shall be reported as 'other special project.' c. For prescription-transfer dispensing cases, if the patient needs an injection along with oral medication, the physician may administer the injection using drugs prepared in the clinic and transfer only the oral medication prescription; the physician may report the injection drug fee (for large-volume IV infusion, the injection technical fee may also be reported), the syringe fee, and the outpatient consultation fee for the transferred dispensing, but may not report the pharmacy service fee; 'prescription dispensing method' shall still be entered as '1 (transfer dispensing).' Right-justify and pad with 0 if insufficient; this fee is the subtotal of medication detail points (item 14) for order category 1 in the order (data format 12); drug fees for transfer dispensing shall not be included in this subtotal; for Western medicine general cases and Chinese medicine, calculate medication reporting points based on days of medication supplied
